entries.title: James 3:1
segments: Do not become many teachers, my brothers, because you know well that we teachers shall be judged by a severer standard than others.

entries.title: James 3:2
segments: For in many respects we often stumble. If any man never stumbles in speech, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body as well.

entries.title: James 3:3
segments: When we put bits in the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we control their whole body also.

entries.title: James 3:4
segments: Look at the ships too, though they are so large, even when driven by fierce winds they are turned by a very small rudder, wherever the impulse of the helmsman wills.

entries.title: James 3:5
segments: So also the tongue is a small member and makes great boasts. Behold, how great a forest is set on fire by a little spark!

entries.title: James 3:6
segments: And the tongue is a fire; it is a very world of iniquity among our members, defiling the whole body, and setting on fire the wheel of nature, and is itself set on fire by hell.

entries.title: James 3:7
segments: For while every kind of beast and bird, and of reptiles and sea-creatures are tamable, and actually have been tamed by mankind,

entries.title: James 3:8
segments: no man can tame the tongue, restless evil that it is, full of deadly poison.

entries.title: James 3:9
segments: With it we continually bless our Lord and Father, and with it we are accustomed to curse men made in the image of God.

entries.title: James 3:10
segments: From out of the same mouth pour forth blessings and cursings! My brothers, this ought not to be so.

entries.title: James 3:11
segments: Does a spring pour forth from the same opening sweet water and bitter?

entries.title: James 3:12
segments: Can a fig tree, my brothers, bear olives; or a grape-vine, figs? No more can salt water yield fresh water.

entries.title: James 3:13
segments: Who among you is wise and intelligent? Let him show his deeds by his good life, in the meekness of wisdom.

entries.title: James 3:14
segments: But if you have bitter jealousy and faction in your heart, do not be boasting of that, and be false to the truth.

entries.title: James 3:15
segments: Such wisdom is not that which is descending from on high, but is earthly, sensual, demonlike.

entries.title: James 3:16
segments: For wherever jealousy and faction exist, there is confusion and every evil deed.

entries.title: James 3:17
segments: But the wisdom which comes from on high is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, conciliatory, overflowing with mercy and good fruits, without partiality and without insincerity.

entries.title: James 3:18
segments: And the fruit of righteousness is being sown in peace by those who are working peace.
